policy: After 09:15 on every live GPW session, the pipeline must end with one best valid stock unless hard data-quality or execution-safety conditions prevent a defensible choice. P0.3 publishes the complete configured GPW universe as one canonical pre-news quantitative ranking, including ranked, investment-screened-out and data-rejected names. P0.4 uses gpw-data-gates-v1 as the single source of truth for historical-session freshness, universe coverage and current-session execution-quote freshness in both the primary and mandatory paths; the duplicate coverage and lag values in this file remain compatibility ceilings and are aligned with the canonical gpw_daily_pick_config.json values. P0.5 uses the configured robust cross-sectional multi-horizon relative-momentum model. The final selector then applies bounded Opening Confirmation and the shared empirical Expected Value model; target R/R is selected by uncertainty-adjusted net expected R rather than a mechanically fixed 1.8 R when EV is enabled.
